messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Katrina Liao <katrina.liao@novacare.com>, Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@novacare.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: SOC 2 Type II report request, temp attestation, and vendor DSQ kickoff

Hi Katrina / Tom — great to meet today, and thanks for the thoughtful questions on data residency and HIPAA scope. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

• What we covered: brief product demo, routing by region, VPC/private option for PHI workloads, and our Dedicated plans for predictable throughput.
• Compliance asks you flagged: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), a short bridge letter/interim attestation if full report delivery will be delayed, and completion of your vendor security questionnaire (DSQ).
• Timeline suggestion: if you can share the DSQ and the primary SOC 2 artifacts this week, we’ll start the review and loop in Security immediately; otherwise, we can provide a temporary attestation while you complete procurement.

Action items: 
1) Katrina/Tom: please confirm preferred point of contact for security artifacts and the DSQ file — email works or I can send a DocuSign/secure upload link.
2) Jordan & Marissa: I’m looping you in to handle the SOC 2 delivery and Trust portal invitation. Marissa — can you provision Novacare for read-only access to our Trust Portal and share the bridge letter template?

Thanks — I’ll hold a 30-minute slot Thurs if that helps to walk through any questionnaire items live.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.com | dylan.brooks@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: SOC 2 Type II report request, temp attestation, and vendor DSQ kickoff

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the summary. Quick answers: we own procurement and security intake here. I’m the primary contact for artifact collection (katrina.liao@novacare.com).

We have two asks before procurement will move forward:
• Recent SOC 2 Type II report (within last 12 months) or an interim attestation that covers any gaps while a Type II is being finalized.
• Completed vendor security questionnaire (attached — small DSQ).

I attached our DSQ as a PDF. Would prefer to upload evidence into your Trust Portal if you can provision access. If portal access isn’t possible, a secure upload link or GrantShare will work. Ideally we’d have the SOC 2 doc or bridge letter by EOD next Wednesday (2026-10-13) to align with our risk committee meeting.

Thanks,
Katrina
Katrina Liao

Hi Katrina — thanks for sending the DSQ. I’m Marissa (InfoSec + Assurance). We’ll get you set up in the Trust Portal for read-only evidence access.

What I’m doing now: 
1) I’ve provisioned a Novacare account in the portal — invite link below. It grants view-only access to our SOC 2 artifacts and attestation documents. Please accept and create a login so we can share files directly.
2) I’m attaching our bridge letter template (filled with redwood contact points). If you need a signed/dated interim attestation before the full report is available, we can generate that from the template.
3) I will also add a short evidence packet (control narratives, scope memo) so your team can start validation while we prepare the full Type II package.

Portal invite: https://trust.redwoodinf.com/invite/novacare-3f8c
Expected SOC 2 Type II availability: our latest period closed 2026-08-31; report delivery ETA: 2026-10-15 (final publication + access). If that timeline slips I’ll send a signed interim attestation earlier.

Let me know who on your side will manage the portal uploads so we can match access levels.

Regards,
Marissa Cole | Head of Security Assurance, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: SOC 2 Type II report request, temp attestation, and vendor DSQ kickoff

Marissa — thanks, I accepted the portal invite and set up an account (username: t.nguyen@novacare.com). I see the bridge letter template in the documents section. Couple quick Qs from our info-sec reviewer: 

• Scope: can you confirm whether PHI is in-scope for the 2026 Type II? We flagged that during the demo and need the scope statement for our internal form.
• Evidence: is there an option to download selected artifacts (we only need control narratives and a copy of the SOC 2 report/attestation)? If downloads are restricted, can you provide an export for our assessment team?

We uploaded the completed DSQ to the portal’s intake area (Novacare_DSQ_20261006.pdf). Target for our risk committee is still 2026-10-13 — if you can confirm the report or provide the interim attestation by EOD 10/13 that would keep us on schedule.

Thanks,
Tom
Security Analyst, Novacare Health
